title: A year in Spain
instructions: Zeynep İspanya'daki öğrenci değişim yılını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; ilk zorlukları, değişenleri ve planlarını ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Two years ago, I spent a year studying in Valencia as an exchange student.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Before I went, I only knew a few words of Spanish, like hello and thank you.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: The first month was really hard. I didn't understand my lessons, and I felt homesick.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: I lived with a Spanish family. They didn't speak any English, so I had to speak Spanish all the time.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: After about three months, everything got easier. I could understand most of my lessons and make jokes with my friends.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: The thing I found strangest was the time people ate. Dinner was at ten at night!

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: I travelled a lot too. My favourite trip was to Granada, in the south.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Now I'm back home, but I still speak to my Spanish family every month.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Next year, I want to do a master's degree in Madrid.

questions.feedback: Valencia'da okudu. Granada en sevdiği gezi, Madrid gelecek planı.
